issue_context.title: Hybrid search don't skip offset results when the keyword results are returned early
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
@inventor123 is reporting that the hybrid search is returning more documents than `limit` when `offset` is not 0.

Looking at the implementation, this can happen when the keyword results are returned early (because the results have a good enough ranking score).

**To Reproduce**
1. Make a hybrid search request with a low semanticRatio, and a non null offset
2. Observe that the returned number of hits is not equal to `limit` and does not skip any result.

**Expected behavior**
The returned hits respect limit and offset

**Meilisearch version:**
v1.6 to v1.8

**Additional context**
https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/discussions/4742
